# Vendor repositories

This directory contains pinned Git submodules. See the licence column in `docs/VENDOR_INTEGRATION.md` before reusing any code.

- `effectcraft` — optional future tooling/orchestration adapter;
- `awesome-opus5-5-videos` — research catalogue only;
- `open-generative-ai` — MIT Next.js/Electron AI image, video and lip-sync studio (generation needs a user MuAPI key);
- `OpenMontage` — AGPL-3.0 agentic video production system (pipelines, tools, provider adapters);
- `react-bits` — MIT + Commons Clause React animated component library;
- `browser-use` — MIT AI browser agent;
- `cc-switch` — MIT Tauri desktop assistant for AI coding tools;
- `FreeCAD` — LGPL-2.1 parametric 3D CAD (pin recorded, working tree not checked out).

See `docs/VENDOR_INTEGRATION.md` and `THIRD_PARTY.md`. Do not edit vendored repositories as if they were Monarch source; contribute upstream or use a studio adapter.
